description: Three-channel quantizer with a transposition that triggers step up and down by a set interval

params.text: Adds a whole number of semitones, 0 to 11, to the transposition; on its own a setting of 6 or more moves the pitch down by that many semitones rather than up
Sets the step the transpose triggers move by, a whole number of semitones from 0 to 20
Picks the scale notes are quantized to: chromatic, blues, major, Dorian, Phrygian, Lydian, Mixolydian, minor or Locrian

inputs.text: A rising edge adds the interval to the running transposition
A rising edge subtracts the interval from the running transposition
Volts added to the transposition, a volt to the octave
Sets the step the transpose triggers move by at 12 semitones to the volt, and the interval knob is ignored while anything is patched here
Picks the scale by whole volts, 0V for chromatic through 8V for Locrian, and the Mode knob is ignored while anything is patched here
Pitch into that channel, a volt to the octave

outputs.text: A 1ms 10V pulse each time the quantized note on that channel changes
The pitch on that channel, transposed and then quantized to the chosen scale

notes: only the fractional part of the transposition is used, and once it reaches half an octave the pitch moves down by it instead of up, so 7 semitones of transposition sounds 7 semitones lower
